pages.text: [#](53341a)Leonard is an old, dark name — the black goat of the sabbath, the lord at the crossroads of infernal commerce.[#]()
pages.title: Shade of Leonard

pages.text: [#](53341a)His Shade does not wander freely; he must be forced into the world through the Witch's Cauldron.[#]()
[#](53341a)Heat and fill the Witch's Cauldron, drop in **Refined Evil**, **Mandrake Root**, a **Tear of the Goddess**, and **Nether Wart**, then hold a **Witches'[#]()
pages.title: Summoning

pages.text: [#](53341a)Hat** and right-click it. The altar must hold at least 10,000 power.[#]()
[#](53341a)Leonard is neutral until struck. Provoked, he retaliates and brands his attacker with a withering curse.[#]()
pages.title: Behaviour

pages.text: [#](53341a)Green souls take harm from anything; red resist all but fire and explosions; black resist all but magic and potions.[#]()
[#](53341a)While any remain, Leonard cannot be harmed.[#]()
[#](53341a)A defeated Shade drops **Leonard's Urn**, a vessel of considerable infernal standing.[#]()
pages.title: Reward

pages.text: [#](53341a)Its precise uses await further investigation — but the standing it confers among creatures of the night is real.[#]()
